reason: A deterministic literature-research plugin that searches multiple scholarly sources, audits topic coverage, extracts paper content, saves papers and PDFs into Zotero, and can trigger RAG reindexing.

summaries.zh: 用于从多个学术数据源检索文献、审计主题覆盖、解析开放获取链接并将论文与 PDF 保存到本地 Zotero 的研究工具。
summaries.en: A research tool that searches multiple scholarly sources, audits topic coverage, resolves open-access links, and saves papers and PDFs to a local Zotero library.

capabilities: Queries multiple scholarly APIs and optional Google Scholar HTML search
Resolves open-access download links and downloads PDFs for text extraction
Writes bibliographic records and PDF attachments to local Zotero via API, SQLite, or inbox files
Triggers incremental zotero-wave-rag reindexing after ingestion
